question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become the permanent public plugin SDK contract for transient tool progress?
rationale: The contract follows an existing progress-kind pattern and avoids Slack text inference, but it adds a third-party API and cross-channel semantic commitment that source correctness alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve Generic Contract
options.body: Keep the public marker and predicate with semantics narrowly limited to transient, non-terminal tool progress.

options.title: Keep Contract Internal
options.body: Retain typed progress intent behind an internal runtime seam until external plugin use is intentionally designed.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Contract
recommendation.body: Keep the public marker and predicate with semantics narrowly limited to transient, non-terminal tool progress.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current Codex producer/progress architecture and authored the latest Slack delivery refactors affected by the decision.
